_comment: Copy to bank_accounts.local.json (not in git). dropFolders: where you save PNC Online Banking downloads (QFX / OFX anywhere in them; CSV in a sub-folder named by the account's code). accounts: the account number's last four digits → the checking account's code in MxAcctMGR (an account's own last four digits, set in MxAcctMGR, map it too).
